title: My data
intro: See what we have about you, download a copy or request erasure. You don't need a dashboard account: sign in with the same Discord you use on the servers.

signIn.scopePrefix: To see your data, we need to confirm it's you. We only use the permission

summary.title: What we have about you
summary.empty: No data found for this Discord.

ownedGuilds.title: Servers you manage
ownedGuilds.bodyPrefix: The data of these servers will
ownedGuilds.bodySuffix: be erased: for this data the server is the controller, and we are only processors. To erase it, remove the Bot from the server; erasure happens 30 days later.

erase.title: Erase my data
erase.delaySuffix: after the request. This wait exists to protect you: if someone takes over your account and requests erasure, there's time to cancel.
erase.retained: Purchases, moderation cases and appeals are not erased, they are anonymized. The law allows these records to be retained, and erasing them would open a way to evade bans.

cancel.noToken: Link without a token. Check that you copied the full address.
cancel.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
cancel.okBody: Your data is still where it was. Nothing was erased.
cancel.okWarning: If you weren't the one who requested erasure, someone may have access to your Discord account. Change your password and turn on two-factor authentication.
cancel.portalHint: You can also cancel by signing in to the portal with your Discord.
